```{r}
  lapply(tbl_paths, function(f) {
    utils::read.csv(f, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }),
  tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(tbl_paths))
)
source(file.path(proj_root, "R", "ch3_report_helpers.R"), local = knitr::knit_global())
```
